newsitem.title: USA: Argentina not ready for floating peso - Cavallo.
newsitem.headline: Argentina not ready for floating peso - Cavallo.

text.p: Domingo Cavallo, former economy minister for Argentina, on Friday said his country was not ready for a free-floating currency or for discretionary monetary policy.
"We are convinced that right now there is no place for monetary policy in a country like Argentina," Cavallo said at a symposium here sponsored by the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City.

Cavallo said that if, at some point in the future, a rapid pickup in productivity in Argentina were to lead to upward pressure on the peso against the dollar, then it might become appropriate for officials to consider allowing the peso to float.
However, he said, at this stage, "It is true that the peso could not float on its own."
